violation_type.title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Accommodations (26 TAC §744.2009(1))
violation_type.short_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Accommodations
violation_type.typical_finding: A child requiring special care did not have an accommodation plan available during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: A child requiring special care did not have an accommodation plan available during the inspection.
Two children in care with special needs did not have accommodations recommended by a health care professional or a qualified professional affiliated with the local school district.

Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it was determined that the accommodation plan was not issued by a health care professional or qualified professional affiliated with the local school district.
